primitives.name: Ordered Git Integration Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Key Decisions Made - Established 4-step deterministic merge sequence: (1) CI repair on main -> (2) PR #1158 -> (3) PR #1157 -> (4) props live board with dual review.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'M': 'merge step index, dimensionless', 'S_M': 'state of merge M, binary {0,1}', 'R_M': 'review status of merge M, binary {0,1}'}
primitives.assumptions: Each merge step is a deterministic function of prior state and CI outcome; review is binary and additive.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When S_M = 0, merge halts; when R_M = 0, dual review required before proceeding.

layer2.mapping: The sequence maps to a Markov chain over merge states with absorbing barriers at CI failure points.
layer2.telemetry: CI success/failure flags and review completion timestamps.

primitives.name: Automated vs Manual Control Boundary
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Established clear automation boundary: schema parity and route probing are automated; Neon console credential rotation and Vercel env updates require user authentication.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'A': 'automation flag, binary {0,1}', 'U': 'user-authentication requirement, binary {0,1}', 'B': 'boundary condition, binary {0,1}'}
primitives.assumptions: Automation is defined by static analysis capability; manual steps require explicit user input.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When A = 1, B = 0; when U = 1, B = 1.

layer2.mapping: Boundary condition defines a control kernel where B = A ⊕ U, separating deterministic and stochastic execution paths.
layer2.telemetry: Execution logs indicating automation vs. manual intervention.

primitives.name: Prop Family Quarantine Invariant
primitives.verbatim_quote: - 25 quarantined prop families identified across book offerings and engine distribution routers - Migration ledger:
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'Q': 'quarantine count, integer', 'F': 'prop family identifier, set', 'L': 'ledger status, binary {0,1}'}
primitives.assumptions: Quarantined families are isolated from production until L = 1.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When Q > 0, F ⊆ Q; when L = 0, propagation blocked.

layer2.mapping: Quarantine invariant mirrors a network cut in a directed graph, isolating nodes with L = 0.
layer2.telemetry: Number of quarantined families and ledger update timestamps.
